scope: Durable Objects architecture alternative; no implementation or deployment

requirements.join: Exact room name and public discovery; same-origin browser checks
requirements.gameplay: Local typing; shared starts and final results
requirements.budget: Workers, SQLite-backed Durable Objects, and KV Free plans only
requirements.identity: Nickname or generated nickname; no login or signed guest credentials
requirements.round_end: First accepted valid completion or round deadline
requirements.rematch: Opt-in, fresh round ID; never extends original room lifetime
requirements.abuse_controls: Server-validated Turnstile for creation and per-browser/IP/room rate limits
requirements.discovery: Batched KV snapshot; room objects authoritative

capacity_numbers: Illustrative only; 50 measured row writes per full room-round is a hypothetical assumption, not a benchmark or room cap
